body:
Good morning!

I've got glue all over my hands today. Could you fetch some things from my shelf for me? I'll leave you a note, so you know what to bring.

Come by the workshop.
summary: Read Mr. Amos's note, and fetch what he needs.
done: You brought just what Mr. Amos needed!

tasks.where: at the workshop in the village
at the jug in your kitchen
